purpose: Execute the actual fixed five-tape99-state caller. Check independent Nat modular A+N*X, final all-ones fuel, unchanged factor/zero, blank prepared scratch, final halt and all five unequal absolute heads. Exhaustive small widths/fuels plus empty fuel and larger padded/wrapping/nonwrapping cases. Universal native trace, halt, numeric and runtime theorems are kernel checked.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.RepeatedAddMachine
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler
open RepeatedAdd CopyMachine

def bits (m a : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map a.testBit

def heads : Port → Int
  | .fuel => 17 | .acc => -11 | .factor => 5 | .scratch => -23 | .zero => 31

def checkCase (m fw n a x : Nat) : Bool := Id.run do
  let fuel := bits fw n
  let acc := bits m a
  let factor := bits m x
  let bound := n*(18*m+31)+8*(n+1)+4*fw
  let final := NativeZipper.run program bound (zipperCfg (.counter 0) (ready fuel acc factor) heads)
  let expected := bits m ((a+n*x) % 2^m)
  let scratch := final.core.tapes .scratch
  return decide (final.core.pc = .counter 12) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .fuel = Counter.marked (List.replicate fw true)) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .acc = BinaryCarry.marked expected) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .factor = BinaryCarry.marked factor) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .zero = BinaryCarry.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (scratch.left = [.start]) && scratch.right.all (fun s => decide (s = .blank)) &&
    decide (final.pos .fuel = 17) && decide (final.pos .acc = -11) &&
    decide (final.pos .factor = 5) && decide (final.pos .scratch = -23) &&
    decide (final.pos .zero = 31)

def allChecks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut count := 0
  let mut failed := 0
  for m in List.range 4 do
    for n in List.range 8 do
      for a in List.range (2^m) do
        for x in List.range (2^m) do
          count := count + 1
          if !(checkCase m 3 n a x) then failed := failed + 1
  for t in [(0,0,0,0,0),(10,5,17,1000,1000),(10,8,3,1,17),(12,5,17,0,100)] do
    count := count + 1
    if !(checkCase t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2.1 t.2.2.2.1 t.2.2.2.2) then failed := failed + 1
  return (count, failed)
#eval allChecks
